evaluation.neat_ep_absolute_tasks: Primary formal absolute-property evaluation is baseline-inclusive. Valid neat EP rows are retained; on neat EP rows, FR-derived molecular/fingerprint/composition/synergy/interaction features are masked, and the task-matching EP_matrix feature is masked where present. Overall metrics are primary; modified-formulation test-subset metrics are reported as sensitivity analysis.
evaluation.delta_tasks: exclude rows with explicit Loading_total_FR=0; retain rows with unknown loading when Delta target is valid
evaluation.strict_validation: 08_ScientificValidation uses nested group CV with fold-internal preprocessing

row_policies.baseline_inclusive: PRIMARY formal absolute-property evaluation. Retains valid neat EP and modified formulations; neat-EP FR-derived features and task-matching EP_matrix feature (where present) are masked. Report overall plus modified-test-subset metrics.
row_policies.modified_only: Sensitivity/subset evaluation using explicit Loading_total_FR > 0 for absolute-property tasks.

formal_protocol.view_k_source: Task-specific view/K predefined from the V4 development-stage systematic sensitivity analyses before the FINAL evaluation.
formal_protocol.inner_cv_selection: Only the predictive model is selected by grouped inner CV within each outer-training fold; the UL94 decision threshold is also estimated from outer-training data only.
formal_protocol.outer_fold_use: Outer folds are used only for evaluation.
formal_protocol.modified_subset_role: Sensitivity/subset evaluation; not the primary formal result.
formal_protocol.preparation_method_encoding: four canonical nominal categories; one-hot only; numeric code retained as metadata
formal_protocol.element_content_definition: P/N/S/B/Si_content wt% are formulation-level elemental contents; legacy *_loading_real fields are loading×composition interactions

project_version_note: Frozen data-release identifier retained for PROJECT_RULES_LOCK/hash compatibility; the formal modeling protocol is identified separately by evaluation.formal_protocol.id.
